description:
Rename the local repository 'legacy-dev-local' to 'module-core-local'. Since Artifactory does not support direct renaming, you must:
1. Create a new local Generic repository named 'module-core-local'.
2. Move all artifacts (specifically the 'org' folder structure) from 'legacy-dev-local' to 'module-core-local'.
3. Delete the old 'legacy-dev-local' repository.

Start from the Artifactory home page. Login credentials are admin / password.
